senses.gloss: Kubera, as one of the four mahārāja(n), see this.
Kubela = Skt. Kubera, n. of a god: LV 〔130.13〕 (vs; but several mss. ˚ra).
Kubjottarā (= Pali Khujjuttarā), n. of a servant of Śyāmāvatī (1): Divy 〔533.5〕; 〔538.10〕; 〔539.16〕; 〔541.4〕; Jm 〔115.24〕 (identified with a slave-girl in a Jātaka, as also in the same Jāt. in Pali).
